meals.name: Vegetarian Quesadillas
ings: 1 cup cheddar or pepper jack cheese
Cilantro, lime, salsa, sour cream to serve
steps: Poke holes in sweet potato, drizzle with oil, wrap in paper towels, microwave 8 min until very tender.
Dice peppers and jalapeño. Cook in pan until tender, 5–7 min. Add beans, corn, and taco seasoning. Cook 3 more min. Set aside.
Butter one side of tortilla. Spread sweet potato on the other, mash ½ avocado over it, add veggie filling, sprinkle cheese.
Cook butter-side down over medium heat until browned and cheese melts. Fold in half. Repeat. Slice and serve warm.
meals.label: Meal A

meals.name: Teriyaki Chicken Tacos with Sesame Cucumber Slaw
ings: 1 avocado sliced, ¼ cup crushed peanuts, sesame seeds
steps: Boil chicken until cooked. Shred chicken.
Thinly slice cucumbers. Whisk dressing ingredients. Toss with cucumbers and herbs.
Spread chicken on lined baking sheet, drizzle with teriyaki and sweet chili sauce. Broil 3–6 min until caramelized.
Warm tortillas. Layer with chicken, cucumber slaw, avocado, crushed peanuts, sesame seeds.
meals.note: 💡 Crockpot: high 2.5–3.5 hrs or low 4–5 hrs. Oven: 400°F for 35 min. Always broil at the end for caramelized edges.
